messages.subject: Question about plotRefToTarget magnitude argument
parts:
Hello, 

I use the plotRefToTarget function to see shape differences between a mean shape and a minimum (or maximum) shape of a PCA. I wonder if setting mag=1 is useful or if it doesn't apply any modification to the original differences between the two shapes?

Thank you in advance. 

Emmanuelle Huet

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Question about plotRefToTarget magnitude argument
parts:
Mag = 1 is the default, and represents the original differences between the shapes.

 

Dean
